## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run docs:check` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the change, including a regression test for a bug fix
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and `AGENT.md` have a dated entry
- [ ] No secrets, addresses, real member data or workout backups are included
